name: Stiiizy | Pro Battery Kit - Black
description:
Compatibility: Works with all STIIIZY pods (note that pods and devices require proper alignment and are not compatible with standard 510-thread carts). 
Heat Technology: Gently warms the oil before a puff for a smoother hit. 
Variable Voltage: Includes multiple power settings (Low, Medium, High) to balance flavor and vapor output.
